source:
🐱‍🏍¡HOY tenemos plan al atardecer! 🧘‍♀️✨

Te invitamos a una clase de estiramientos + Sunset para desconectar, mover el cuerpo y disfrutar juntos del atardecer. 🌅💛

🕖 19:00 h
📍 Nos encontramos en la zona de la piscina
🧴 Trae agua
🧘‍♀️ Y no olvides tu toalla

Ven con ropa cómoda y ganas de relajarte. ¡Te esperamos! 💙

¡Muévete, respira y disfruta del atardecer! 🌅

---

🌅 TODAY we have a sunset plan! 🧘‍♀️✨

Join us for a stretching + Sunset class to unwind, move your body and enjoy the sunset together. 🌅💛

🕖 19:00 h
📍 Meet us by the pool area
🧴 Bring water
🧘‍♀️ And don’t forget your towel

Come in comfortable clothes and ready to relax. See you there! 💙

Move, breathe and enjoy the sunset! 🌅

text.headlineEs: Clase de estiramientos y sunset: muévete, respira y disfruta del atardecer.

notes: Artur's own model text, already in both languages, so the share text is his text as it came. The team had made an image for it elsewhere (headline 'Clase de ESTIRAMIENTOS y SUNSET', 19:00 h, HOY, lleva una toalla, lleva agua, quedamos en la zona de la piscina, '¡Muévete, respira y disfruta del atardecer!'): the headlines follow it, in English first. No sign-up in the text, so the ask is the text's own 'See you there' / '¡Te esperamos!' instead of the reception default. 'Today' and 'TODAY' only read right on the day: a flyer for a later day says the weekday and date.
